sources.title: Supernova11c/Supernova-Nepali-Tokenizer · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A high-performance, production-ready Byte-Level BPE tokenizer specifically engineered for the Nepali language and Devanagari script. Developed as part of the Supernova project to enable efficient and accurate Nepali LLM processing.

sources.title: Supernova11c/Supernova-Prototype · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Important This is NOT the final Supernova model. The current checkpoint is a pipeline prototype using a fallback/dummy dataset. It is intended to verify the custom architecture, tokenizer, training and export pipeline. The final Supernova model will be trained from scratch using the real Supernova/Nepali dataset.

sources.title: HimalayaAI - Open Nepali AI Research
sources.snippet: A 0.5B parameter language model trained on Nepali language, available on Hugging Face. An open-source knowledge platform for use of AI in Education. A Nepali language tokenizer optimized for NLP tasks and large language model training. Large-scale text corpus in Parquet for GPT-2-style language model pretraining and tokenizer research.
